description.value: Chef's Playground Eatery is a brunch, burger, and beer restaurant in the Steveston area of Richmond, BC, committed to sourcing fresh, seasonal ingredients from local farmers' markets. The kitchen crafts dishes with creativity and passion, and the restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout options. It is a neighbourhood gathering spot built around quality, locally driven seasonal cuisine.
